title: Crimewave
overview:
This is a true highway racer. And with shooting, too - can you survive this urban war...?

Crime has overrun the futuristic city of Mekeo, and its mayor now pays bounties to the officers of the Mekeo Vehicle Police for every wanted criminal taken down. Patrol the streets from an overhead view in a heavily armed police car, hunt down armed criminals on wheels and blow them away to earn bounty money, called Meks, before time runs out.

- Rival cops chase the same bounties and will open fire on you too
- Grab extra weapons and ammo from pickups and wrecked enemies
- Wrecking civilian cars costs you Meks
- Hit the target totals to open new districts of the city, such as the casino district
- Supports the racing controller and the mission stick

これぞ本物の街道レーサー。しかもシューティングで、この都会戦争を生き残れるか・・・？
